# FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry

**几何重试 receipt 与期望**

证明几何重试第 n 次失败后成功的精确 receipt 质量与 never=0 时的期望费用 good+bad·coin(false)/coin(true)。

**边界**：仅覆盖固定 good/bad 价格的两结果重试，不含一般停止器、fair-bit 后端或资源实现。

**覆盖等级**：A-

| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_positive` | theorem | L50 | When both branch costs are positive, every nonzero retry transition pays at least one unit of cost. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_point` | theorem | L62 | The halted point mass after `n + 1` steps splits into a failed trial followed by an `n`-step run and an immediate successful trial. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_below_good` | theorem | L75 | A successful halt has zero finite-run mass at every cost below the successful branch cost. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_false` | theorem | L88 | The retry program never halts with Boolean output `false` in any finite run. |
| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_halt_recursion` | theorem | L96 | The unbounded successful halt mass satisfies the recurrence obtained by separating an initial failure from immediate success. |

| `Qatlib.Concepts.FairRandomBits.GeometricRetry.branchRetry_support` | theorem | L139 | Every cost carrying nonzero successful halt mass equals `n * bad + good` for some natural number `n`. |
